files.summary: track the live legacy packing fallback alongside its unused converter
edits: The October 6 review at `5241f667` also traces the converter’s `itemHandling.packingLoads` output to a still-live fallback in `objects.ts` (`ownLoad`) and validation in `item-handling.ts`; no other non-test application producer was found. Retire that compatibility-only field, reader and validator path together, preserving explicitly authored current packing metadata, exact definition pins and current live-edit integrity. Removing the unused converter alone does not remove the loading/packing exposure, and missing load must not silently become zero. The base-world item guide now distinguishes authored new-world creation from unsupported missing-default repair on load.
